prompt: With scanbot1, measure how far the nearest person is with cam_scan1 and, if it is less than 2 metres, tell channel "lead" "person close".
why: A reading of a person (0044 K8, G-PROX): a person is not an object of the world, so there is nothing to bind and no sensor can declare a reading of one. Limits and reactions to people nearby are the gap G-PROX.
